evidence_files: human_study/evo/roles/safety/s01_geometry.py (prepared, NOT run: Python execution not permitted for this role; geometry numbers below are read from human_study/fsu/endplates_footprint.png, +/-0.2 mm, until the script is run)

constraints.what: stays inside the disc space (inset footprint, between endplates)
constraints.harm_prevented: contact with spinal cord / dura (posterior), nerve roots and vertebral artery (lateral, beyond the uncinate processes), oesophagus (anterior)
constraints.why_not_sufficient: checks the as-built position only. Posterior margin is only 1.0 mm (footprint edge 1 mm anterior of the posterior vertebral wall, PLL resected: DECISIONS.md:19, figure endplates_footprint.png). A 1 mm posterior translation (the agreed slip limit, DECISIONS.md:723) puts the cage edge at the canal. Lateral margin is adequate: footprint |Y| <= 5.7 mm, disc outline 6.7 mm; vertebral artery lies lateral of the uncinate process (uncinate lateral wall to artery 1.7-2.8 mm; medial uncinate margin to transverse foramen ~5 mm).
constraints.measurable: yes, L0 geometry (by construction); the loaded position belongs to S9
constraints.recommended_value: inset 1 mm all round (as now) AND the posterior cage edge must never cross the posterior vertebral wall line in any loaded state (see S9 posterior limit)
constraints.range: inset 1.0-1.5 mm posterior; 1.0 mm lateral / anterior
references: DECISIONS.md:19, 27; human_study/fsu/endplates_footprint.png

'Anatomical morphometric study of the cervical uncinate process and surrounding structures', J Korean Neurosurg Soc, PMID 23133716 (uncinate-artery distance 1.7-2.8 mm lateral wall, 3.6-6.1 mm tip) - first-author name unverified
Siriraj Med J morphometric study, https://he02.tci-thaijo.org/index.php/sirirajmedj/article/download/258793/176468 (medial uncinate margin to transverse foramen 5.0 +/- 0.9 mm) - authors unverified
constraints.plain_zh: 整個支架只能放在兩節頸椎之間的椎間盤空間內，四周再往內縮 1 毫米。就像把書放進書架格子，不能凸出格子外：後面是脊髓，旁邊是神經和椎動脈，前面是食道。注意：後方只留 1 毫米，所以支架往後滑 1 毫米就會碰到椎管邊緣。

constraints.what: insertable in one piece from anterior after 0.8x compression; Y width <= anterior opening
constraints.harm_prevented: an implant that cannot be inserted, or that is damaged / forced during insertion (cracks, debris, endplate damage, over-distraction)
constraints.why_not_sufficient: (1) Gap shape: native gap anterior 2.7 mm vs mid 5.4-5.5 mm (DECISIONS.md:15). Passing the anterior gap needs a height ratio (2.7+d)/(5.5+d) = 0.53-0.60 for d 0.5-1.5 (notes G2), not 0.8 -> with the default rule almost any part filling the posterior disc space fails, unless an insertion distraction d_ins > d is allowed. (2) Material: 20 % compression exceeds the elastic limit of hard PLCL 85:15 in every material set (strength/modulus 1.7-16 %, notes G2) -> permanent deformation / cracking; only the soft 50:50 elastomer recovers. (3) The simulated 'expand' insertion (h14_build_case.py:41,47,355-358) is a stress-free natural-shape shrink, so neither the sliding path nor the insertion strain is simulated.
constraints.measurable: path check yes (L0 geometry sweep along -X); insertion strain NO with the current model - needs an L0/L1 strain check of the compressed state
constraints.recommended_value: redefine: (a) temporary insertion distraction d_ins (PI to set; surgical Caspar distraction, value unverified - propose d_ins = d + 1 mm, capped at total +2 mm over native) ; (b) the part slides along -X through the gap at d_ins with its compressed shape; (c) max principal strain in the compressed state <= elastic limit of the local blend (phi-dependent, from the strength / modulus sets); (d) Y width <= anterior opening (chord ~11 mm, read from figure, to be computed by s01_geometry.py)
constraints.range: d_ins - d: 0-1.5 mm; allowed compression: elastomer regions up to 20-30 %, hard regions <= strength/modulus (low set 1.7 %)
references: DECISIONS.md:15, 22, 46, 115; scripts/3_cage_case/h14_build_case.py:41,47,355-358; notes G2

over-distraction >= 2 mm raises subsidence and adjacent-segment pathology: 'The impact of over-distraction on adjacent segment pathology and cage subsidence in ACDF', Sci Rep 2023, doi:10.1038/s41598-023-44998-4 (PMID 37898696)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架必須能整個一塊從脖子前方塞進去。像把沙發搬進門：門口（前方椎間隙約 2.7 毫米加撐開量）比房間內（後方約 5.5 毫米）窄很多，要壓扁到原來高度的一半多才進得去；硬的材料被壓那麼多會壓壞，只有軟材料能回彈。目前的模擬沒有真的模擬「壓扁再滑進去」這一步。

constraints.what: one connected solid part (6-connectivity), no loose pieces
constraints.harm_prevented: loose fragments migrating toward the cord / foramen; uncontrolled load paths
constraints.why_not_sufficient: connectivity at time zero only. Thin bridges can break under load or during degradation (polylactide strength loss starts ~6-12 months; larger parts degrade faster inside by autocatalysis: Wuisman & Smit 2005) and become loose pieces. A single-voxel (0.2 mm) face connection also counts as connected but is not a printable / strong joint.
constraints.measurable: yes, L0 (connected-component labelling); robustness needs a minimum cross-section check (see S5)
constraints.recommended_value: one 6-connected component AND every bridge / strut cross-section >= 0.8 x 0.4 mm (2 lines x 2 layers), so no piece hangs on a single voxel
references: Wuisman PIJM, Smit TH 2005, Eur Spine J, 'Bioresorbable polymers: heading for a new generation of spinal cages', https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3489405
constraints.plain_zh: 支架必須是一整塊，沒有分離的小碎塊。就像一串鑰匙要串在同一個圈上，掉下來的小碎片可能跑到脊髓旁邊。建議連接處不要細到只有一顆像素那麼細，否則日後材料慢慢分解時容易斷開。

constraints.what: biodisc space: void connected to both endplates, >= 30 % of disc-space volume
constraints.harm_prevented: loss of the purpose (no room / no nutrient path for the tissue-engineered biodisc)
constraints.why_not_sufficient: (1) 30 % has no literature basis (PI dropped the 60 % window, DECISIONS.md:711) - it is a floor, acceptable as such, value unverified. (2) Connectivity alone allows a hair-thin channel; disc cells receive nutrients mainly by diffusion through the endplates, so the void's CONTACT AREA on each endplate matters, not only its volume. (3) It is not defined how the biodisc gets into the void (pre-loaded before insertion vs filled after); an enclosed cavity cannot be filled.
constraints.measurable: yes, L0 (voxel counting, flood fill from both endplate layers)
constraints.recommended_value: >= 30 % void volume (floor) AND void contact area >= 30 % of the footprint area on EACH endplate AND minimum channel width >= 1 mm AND void reachable for filling (PI to state filling method)
references: DECISIONS.md:711-712

endplate diffusion as the main nutrient route of the disc: Urban JPG, Smith S, Fairbank JCT 2004, Spine 29:2700 'Nutrition of the intervertebral disc' (cited from memory, not re-checked this round: unverified)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架裡要留至少三成的空洞給生物椎間盤長，而且空洞要同時碰到上下兩塊椎骨。就像花盆要有足夠的土，底部也要有排水孔：生物椎間盤靠上下骨頭表面「滲」養分，所以空洞貼在骨頭上的面積也要夠大，不能只是一條細管。

constraints.what: printable: min feature 0.4 mm X-Y, 0.2 mm layers, 45 deg overhang rule (build along Z)
constraints.harm_prevented: designs that cannot be manufactured or that print with defects (weak layers, sagging overhangs)
constraints.why_not_sufficient: 0.4 mm = one extrusion line; a single-line wall in a load path is fragile and its inter-layer strength is only 0.8 x bulk (DECISIONS.md:116). The soft PLCL 50:50 elastomer probably cannot bridge / overhang like a rigid filament (unverified). The build direction Z puts layer interfaces parallel to the endplates, i.e. the shear plane during slip is the weakest plane.
constraints.recommended_value: min feature 0.4 mm for non-load-bearing, 0.8 mm (2 lines) for any strut in the main load path; overhang <= 45 deg for hard (phi >= threshold) voxels, <= 30 deg (or fully supported) for soft voxels until printing trials exist
constraints.range: min load-bearing feature 0.8-1.2 mm; overhang 30-45 deg
references: ISO/ASTM 52910:2018 Additive manufacturing - Design - Requirements, guidelines and recommendations (overhang / minimum feature guidance; values printer-specific)
DECISIONS.md:51, 73-74, 116
constraints.plain_zh: 設計必須能用 3D 列印機印出來：線寬 0.4 毫米、每層 0.2 毫米，懸空部分不能斜過 45 度。就像疊積木，上一層不能伸出下一層太多，否則會塌。建議承重的柱子至少兩條線寬（0.8 毫米），一條線太細容易斷。

constraints.what: load capacity >= 1164 N compression before failure
constraints.harm_prevented: cage collapse under maximal neck muscle effort
constraints.why_not_sufficient: (1) 1164 N is the mean computed C4-5 compression in maximal voluntary efforts (Moroney, Schultz & Miller 1988 J Orthop Res 6:713) - correct source; NOT the 1988 J Biomech paper (compression only to 73.6 N). (2) 1164 N exceeds the mean cervical endplate failure load 1084 +/- 314 N (Schroder 2006); v2 runs already ended by bone yield at 230-277 N (DECISIONS.md:584-586) -> if 'failure' includes bone, no design can pass. (3) Time zero only: PLCL loses strength over months and creeps at 37 C (see missing items) - the end-of-maturation state is not checked. (4) Static only; no fatigue.
constraints.measurable: yes with L2 compression test (existing); L1 estimate
constraints.recommended_value: >= 1164 N before CAGE failure (damage volume / collapse, low strength set), bone failure handled by S8; additionally >= 1164 N with the end-of-maturation (degraded) strength once the PI gives the maturation period
constraints.range: 800-1164 N (lower values only if the PI accepts restricted activity / collar during maturation)
references: Moroney SP, Schultz AB, Miller JAA 1988, J Orthop Res 6:713-720, 'Analysis and measurement of neck loads', https://deepblue.lib.umich.edu/items/47a2045f-582d-4aa7-b571-7ea85a34f362
Schroder J, Herbort M, Rustemeyer P, Vieth V, Wassmann H 2006, Cent Eur Neurosurg 67(4):188-192, doi:10.1055/s-2006-942279 (endplate failure 1084 +/- 314 N, 10.47 MPa)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架要能撐住約 1164 牛頓（約 119 公斤重）的壓力而不壞，這是人用力繃緊脖子時頸椎承受的最大壓力。就像椅子要撐得住一個人用力坐下。注意：這個力已經比骨頭本身能承受的平均值還大，所以只應判斷「支架本身有沒有壞」，骨頭有沒有被壓壞另由 S8 判斷；而且材料會隨時間變弱，要檢查使用期末的強度。

constraints.harm_prevented: loss of distraction -> loss of foraminal height (nerve root compression) and of clamp force (fixation)
constraints.why_not_sufficient: elastic, instantaneous only. Under a sustained ~100-150 N for months PLCL creeps at 37 C (copolymer modulus drops strongly between 22 and 37 C; creep / stress relaxation are known issues for polymeric implants) - creep height loss and loss of clamp force are not measured. 150 N has no cited source (order of a follower load with head weight; unverified).
constraints.measurable: elastic part yes (L1 / L2); creep NO with the current models (all materials hyperelastic, no viscoelasticity)
constraints.recommended_value: elastic height loss <= d/2 at 150 N (keep) AND total height loss incl. creep over the maturation period <= d/2 (needs creep data or a coupon test)
references: DECISIONS.md:33
PLCL modulus 2985 MPa at 22 C -> 664 MPa at 37 C (shape-memory PLCL, search result https://abjs.mums.ac.ir/article_13637.html ; exact composition unverified)
constraints.plain_zh: 在 150 牛頓（約 15 公斤重）的壓力下，支架高度減少不能超過撐開量的一半。就像千斤頂撐住車子，不能慢慢往下沉；高度一掉，神經出口變窄，支架也夾不緊。問題是塑膠在體溫下會像橡皮糖一樣慢慢變形（潛變），目前的模擬看不到這種長時間的下沉。

constraints.what: no endplate overload: peak 1 mm2-averaged contact pressure below a subsidence proxy
constraints.harm_prevented: subsidence (cage sinking into bone) -> loss of height, malalignment, loss of fixation
constraints.why_not_sufficient: (1) No number and no load state are defined ('calibrated on FEBio'). (2) Endplate strength varies widely and is location dependent (posterior stronger; Cheng 2007) and drops 44 % when the endplate is burred 1 mm. (3) Evaluated at 1164 N every design would fail (mean pressure over ~100 mm2 ~ 11-12 MPa > 10.5 MPa mean failure) - so the load state must be daily-life loads with a safety factor.
constraints.measurable: yes, L1 contact pressure; L2 FEBio strain-based yield (DECISIONS.md:108-109) as reference
constraints.recommended_value: peak 1 mm2-averaged pressure <= 5 MPa in every physiological state (100 N follower + 1.5 N m, 6 directions) and at 150 N; L2 check: yielded trabecular volume < 10 % (existing criterion)
constraints.range: 3-10 MPa (3 MPa ~ weak bone: Cheng 2007 mean-1SD 2.8 MPa; 10 MPa ~ Schroder 2006 mean 10.5 MPa)
references: Cheng CC, Ordway NR, Zhang X, Lu YM, Fang H, Fayyazi AH 2007, Spine, doi:10.1097/BRS.0b013e31811ece5a (3 mm indenter: intact 106 +/- 86 N = 15.0 MPa; burred 1 mm 59 N = 8.3 MPa; notes G3)
Schroder J et al. 2006, Cent Eur Neurosurg 67:188, doi:10.1055/s-2006-942279 (10.47 MPa mean)
Morgan EF, Keaveny TM 2001, J Biomech 34:569 (trabecular yield strains; as DECISIONS.md:108)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架壓在骨頭上的力道不能太集中，否則會像高跟鞋踩進草地一樣陷進骨頭（下陷）。建議：日常姿勢下，任何 1 平方毫米的壓力不超過 5 百萬帕（約每平方公分 50 公斤重），骨質差的人要更低。這一點目前還沒有數字，需要主持人決定。

constraints.what: posterior push-out >= anterior push-out; no expulsion under physiological loads
constraints.harm_prevented: cage migration into the canal (cord injury) or anteriorly (oesophagus, loss of support) - the main goal
constraints.why_not_sufficient: (1) Relative only: a design with both push-out forces tiny passes. (2) The 1 mm translation limit (DECISIONS.md:723) equals the whole posterior margin (S1) -> posterior limit needs a margin. (3) 3 cycles (DECISIONS.md:729) show only the per-cycle increment; over a maturation period with many neck-motion cycles even 1 um/cycle accumulates to mm (notes G5). (4) Time zero only: stress relaxation of PLCL lowers the clamp force -> friction drops over time. (5) Friction-only push-out at 100 N preload is 2*mu*100 = 40-70 N plus clamp share, well below clinical comparators 142-304 N (DECISIONS.md:135, devices with keels / teeth), so a literature push-out floor from those devices would be unattainable without shape interlock.
constraints.measurable: yes with the real-friction GPU solver (gate 4 pending, VERIFICATION.md) and L2 push-out; ratchet extrapolation needs a rule
constraints.recommended_value: (a) posterior push-out >= anterior push-out; (b) posterior push-out (100 N preload) >= 135 N (maximal in-vivo AP shear, Moroney 1988) at mu = 0.2; (c) cage-centre translation <= 1 mm in any direction AND <= 0.5 mm posteriorly over 6 directions x 3 cycles; (d) per-cycle increment x cycles of the maturation period <= the same limits; (e) re-check (c) with the end-of-maturation clamp force
constraints.range: posterior translation limit 0.3-0.5 mm; push-out floor 70-142 N
references: Moroney et al. 1988 J Orthop Res 6:713 (AP shear up to 135 N, lateral 125 N)
DECISIONS.md:135, 723, 729; METHODS_COMPARISON.md section A
posterior cage migration can cause cord injury; migration incidence ~6 % (review, Medicina 2023, https://www.mdpi.com/1648-9144/59/5/956)
constraints.plain_zh: 這是最重要的一條：支架不可以滑出來，尤其不能往後滑向脊髓。就像門擋，往脊髓方向要比往外更推不動，而且要有最低的「推不動」力量，不只是相對比較。後方只有 1 毫米空間，所以建議往後最多只能滑 0.5 毫米；每次轉頭若都滑一點點，幾個月累積起來也會滑出來，所以要把每一次的小滑動乘上總次數來判斷。

missing_items.item: time-dependent material behaviour over the biodisc maturation period: creep, stress relaxation (clamp force -> friction), hydrolytic strength / modulus loss
missing_items.why: fixation by friction depends on the clamp force; a viscoelastic PLCL cage at 37 C relaxes, so time-zero results overestimate fixation. Polylactide strength drops from ~6-12 months (Wuisman & Smit 2005); maturation period is not defined anywhere (grep 'matur|month|week|creep' in DECISIONS.md: only lines 618, 638, no duration).
missing_items.proposal: PI gives the maturation period; S6 / S7 / S9 evaluated at time zero AND at end of period with degraded / relaxed properties (coupon creep + degradation tests at 37 C wet; until then a sensitivity e.g. clamp force x 0.5, modulus x 0.5)
references: Wuisman & Smit 2005 Eur Spine J, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3489405

missing_items.why: see S2: hard PLCL cannot recover 20 % compression; no instrument interface (grip / impactor face) or insertion force limit is defined; h14 'expand' insertion is stress-free
missing_items.proposal: S2 redefinition (CR-S2); require a flat anterior impaction face of >= X mm2 (PI / surgeon to set) and report peak insertion force
references: scripts/3_cage_case/h14_build_case.py:41,47,355-358

missing_items.item: imaging: PLCL is radiolucent, so migration and subsidence cannot be seen on X-ray / CT follow-up
missing_items.why: PEEK cages carry metal markers because the polymer is invisible on X-ray / CT; a PLCL-only cage gives no way to detect the main failure (migration). Advantage: no MRI artefact (non-metallic), MRI can follow the biodisc.
missing_items.proposal: PI decision: allow radiopaque markers (e.g. tantalum beads) or radiopaque filler as an exception to 'PLCL-only', or accept MRI-only follow-up
references: Radiopaque polymeric spinal cages: a prototype study, https://core.ac.uk/works/100918905 ; 'PEEK cages do not show up in CT images, so small metallic markers are usually incorporated' (search summary, unverified wording)

missing_items.item: acidic degradation products and debris (local osteolysis, inflammation)
missing_items.why: resorbable polylactide cages: 0-22 % of patients with irritation, sterile sinus or osteolysis in early literature (Wuisman & Smit 2005); larger / thicker parts degrade faster inside (autocatalysis). Total polymer mass and maximum wall thickness are free in evo.
missing_items.proposal: report total PLCL volume and maximum local wall thickness for every design as tracked metrics (no hard limit yet; PI may set one)
references: Wuisman & Smit 2005 Eur Spine J

missing_items.why: gamma irradiation reduces PLCL molecular weight ~33 %; ethylene oxide leaves it unchanged; PLCL cannot be autoclaved (unverified for this grade). The material property sets should be post-sterilisation values.
missing_items.proposal: state ethylene oxide as assumed method; coupons tested after sterilisation
references: Effect of ethylene oxide and gamma sterilization on the properties of a PLCL polymer material in balloon implants (Hebrew Univ., https://cris.huji.ac.il/en/publications/effect-of-ethylene-oxide-and-gamma-%CE%B3-sterilization-on-the-propert/)

missing_items.why: index disc height increase >= 2 mm raises subsidence (47 vs 31 %) and adjacent-segment pathology, and facet force / neck pain; current d range 0.5-1.5 mm is below 2 mm -> OK, but the evo gene d and any insertion distraction must stay below it
missing_items.proposal: hard limit: d <= 1.5 mm and total construct height <= native + 2 mm (incl. d_ins during insertion as temporary only)

missing_items.item: segmental alignment (lordosis / kyphosis) change by a free-form height field
missing_items.why: contour matching keeps the native angle (DECISIONS.md:29); free-form designs plus uneven creep could tilt the segment; not checked
missing_items.proposal: report C3-C4 sagittal angle change after insertion and after 150 N; limit proposal +/- 3 deg (value unverified, PI to decide)
references: unverified

missing_items.why: model assumes an intact bony endplate of an idealised 26 y.o. (DECISIONS.md:8, 18); burring 1 mm removes 44 % of endplate strength (Cheng 2007); an older patient (59 / 64 y.o. models, DECISIONS.md:71) has weaker bone and a different shape -> a contour-matched free-form part may not fit
missing_items.proposal: finalists re-checked on the 59 / 64 y.o. models (already planned) and with S8 at the 3 MPa end of the range
references: Cheng et al. 2007 Spine

missing_items.why: no constraints.py anywhere in the repository (Glob **/constraints*.py: none, 2026-10-26), although GOVERNANCE.md:23 lists it; L0 cannot run

friction_literature.recommendation: real-friction GPU test: sweep mu = 0.1, 0.2, 0.35, 0.5 and report mu_req; deciding (worst) value mu = 0.2 (keeps DECISIONS.md:667-668), nominal 0.35 (smooth-implant-on-human-bone 0.37-0.41), lower sensitivity 0.15 because published values are dry while the in-vivo interface is wet and the soft PLCL 50:50 surface is a hydrated elastomer (direction of the wet effect unverified). summary_zh:
安全守門員第 1 輪結論（目前還沒有任何設計，只審查規則本身）：
1. 九條限制（S1 到 S9）都該保留，但大多「不夠」，而且目前程式裡完全沒有實作（找不到 constraints.py），需由整合者寫出來。
2. 最嚴重的兩點：(a) S2「從前方塞入」：前方椎間隙只有約 2.7 毫米加撐開量，後方約 5.5 毫米，支架要壓到原高度的 53% 到 60% 才進得去，不是預設的 80%；硬的聚乳酸-己內酯共聚物（PLCL 85:15）被壓 20% 就會永久變形或裂開，而現在的模擬是讓支架「憑空縮小」，並沒有真的模擬壓扁和滑入。(b) 時間因素：塑膠在體溫下會慢慢變形、夾緊力會慢慢鬆掉、強度會隨分解下降；支架不滑出主要靠夾緊力產生的摩擦，所以只看剛植入當下的結果會高估固定效果。需要主持人提供「生物椎間盤需要多久長成」。
3. 脊髓安全：支架後緣離椎管只有 1 毫米（後縱韌帶已切除），建議往後滑動上限改為 0.5 毫米，並設一個最低的往後推出力（建議 135 牛頓，依據 Moroney 1988 測得的頸部最大前後剪力）；每次轉頭的微小滑動要乘以總次數來判斷。側邊的椎動脈距離足夠（約 5 毫米外）。
4. 骨頭下陷（S8）目前沒有數字，建議日常姿勢下每平方毫米壓力不超過 5 百萬帕（範圍 3 到 10）。S6 的 1164 牛頓比骨頭本身的平均破壞力（1084 牛頓）還高，應只判斷支架本身是否壞掉。
5. 摩擦係數：找不到塑膠（PLCL、聚乳酸 PLA、聚醚醚酮 PEEK）直接在椎骨終板上的實測值；光滑植入物在人骨上量到 0.16 到 0.41（乾燥條件）。建議真實摩擦模擬用 0.1、0.2、0.35、0.5 四個值，最壞情況用 0.2 判斷。
6. 另外缺少：X 光看不到純塑膠支架（無法追蹤是否移位，需決定是否加顯影標記）、分解產生的酸性物質、滅菌方式（建議環氧乙烷，伽瑪射線會讓材料分子量降約三成）、撐開過度（目前 0.5 到 1.5 毫米，低於文獻警戒的 2 毫米，沒問題）。
所有數值仍是建議，需主持人核准才會改動。幾何數字目前是從圖上讀的（誤差約 0.2 毫米），因為本角色無法執行程式，已備好腳本請其他角色執行。
